decision: Orchestration billed to credit (planner model cost x PLATFORM_FEE_RATE), flag ORCHESTRATION_BILLING_ENABLED default true
why: Satya: orchestration is billed; fee stays one backend constant

decision: Cumulative-cost billing (ceil of cumulative fee-inclusive cents minus billed) instead of per-turn rounding

why: Observed clean runs $0.41-$0.69 model cost, P1 $0.98 with retries; designer's 1.4x/$0.25 rule

decision: Run-level cap and estimate (one hold per run), repeated on every card of a pause
why: Orchestration spans the run; cap must be a hard stop for the whole run

decision: Hold at run start (default orchestration cap) and raise it at approval
why: Autonomous runs have no approval card but still bill planning

decision: Planner turn over the cap is clipped, run pauses, overage is billed as catch-up only after the user raises the cap
why: Never charge above the cap; cost is only known after a turn

decision: Unknown model (no MODEL_RATES entry) is not billed
Unpriced media step is shown at 0 with estimate_incomplete=true
why: Approvals for unknown costs existed before; do not guess

decision: status gains "rejected" beyond the designer's list
why: A rejected card has no run state

decision: Lines use price_cents (spec section 8 suggested cents)
Receipt shows balance_before/after as daily allowance + wallet (spendable), not minus other runs' holds
why: Matches what the user actually has

decision: Tool-call name stays in client execution payloads; label/provider/summary/errors scrubbed
why: Studio canvas logic keys off the machine name; UI must hide it

decision: Failed runs bill what was actually charged (media refunds remove the line; orchestration is not refunded)
Stale holds released after ORCHESTRATION_HOLD_TTL_SECONDS (6 h)
why: Crashed runs must not lock credit
